{{recipesummary|category=Beef recipes|servings=8|time=Prep: 10 minutes
Cooking: 20 minutes|difficulty=2 }}{{recipe}} '''Sloppy joes''' are loosemeat sandwiches that have roots in the cuisine of the Midwestern United States. ==Ingredients== *1 [[Cookbook:Pound|pound]] (450 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]]) ground [[Cookbook:Beef|beef]] *1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Ketchup|ketchup]] *1 cup [[Cookbook:Barbecue Sauce|barbecue sauce]] *1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Garlic Powder|garlic powder]] *1 tbsp [[Cookbook:Chili Powder|chili powder]] *¼ cup chopped [[Cookbook:Onion|onion]] (optional) *¼ cup chopped green [[Cookbook:Bell Pepper|bell pepper]] (optional) ==Procedure== #Brown the ground beef, onions, and peppers in [[Cookbook:Frying Pan|skillet]] on medium heat. #Drain the liquid from the mixture. #Place the ground beef back on the skillet. #While on medium heat mix in the ketchup, barbecue sauce, garlic powder, and chili powder in any order. #[[Cookbook:Simmering|Simmer]] for 20 minutes. #Serve over sliced, toasted hamburger buns. ==See also== * [[Cookbook:Meatless Sloppy Joes|Meatless Sloppy Joes]] [[Category:Recipes using ground beef]] [[Category:Recipes using barbecue sauce]] [[Category:Pan fried recipes]] [[Category:Recipes for sandwiches]] [[Category:Midwestern U.S. recipes]] [[Category:Recipes_with_metric_units]] [[Category:Kid-friendly recipes]] [[Category:Recipes using green bell pepper]] [[Category:Recipes using chili powder]] [[Category:Recipes using garlic powder]] [[Category:Recipes using ketchup]]
